SELECT "business_date", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "ultimate_parent_party_name", "issuer_name", "parent_security_type_name", "security_type_name", "security_name", "total_market_value_pc", "security_name_clean", "combined_entity_name_original", "combined_entity_name_clean", "department_sorted"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name, '' ) as combined_entity_name_original
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name_clean, '' ) as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'
	  	  end department_sorted
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaptions|option|future|contract|deposit|paper|collateralized|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			  end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final) AS "holdings_search_holdings_lookthrough"

/* cppi::3f48957fe265a56286fa3e99108b9f46505631918d3042fba896d3917f9f02b1 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 13
		AND hour between 22 and 23
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-13 22:41:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::f9476a108fa3d96b9634d49fe3bce44c5a3a3f380f9b5e163370d63bf5431fb2 */
with date_adjusted as (
    select business_date, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name, arrival_time,
        case
            when True and rm_name = 'cashRate' then date_add('day', 1, business_date)
            else business_date
        end as business_date_adj
    from market.tfm_risk_model_daily
    where business_date between date_add('day', -1, date '2025-04-07') and date '2025-04-07'
    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-12-31'
),
max_arrival_time as (
    select *,
        max(arrival_time) over (partition by rm_id, business_date_adj) as max_publish
    from date_adjusted
    where business_date_adj between date '2025-04-07' and date '2025-04-07'
)
select business_date, business_date_adj, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name
from max_arrival_time
where arrival_time = max_publish

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 13
		AND hour between 15 and 16
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-13 15:41:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%4'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-13'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%4'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-13'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%4'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 13
		AND hour between 22 and 23
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-13 22:20:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::e88e53f0f55acebf8bf1ca649a093fd0278996b4ab54248b3733c6d76402302a */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 13
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-13 10:36:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-13 16:15:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

		SELECT
			client_ip,

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy != 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap' then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy + f.abacus_pv_base_ccy

WITH date_params AS (
SELECT DATE '2020-04-01' AS start_date, DATE '2025-03-31' AS end_date
)
SELECT 'F25' as "FY", DLY.adjusted_fx_currency,
EXP(SUM(LN(1 + TWR_Currency_Adjusted_FX))) - 1 TWR_Currency_Adjusted_FX,
sum(pnl_currency_exposure_fx) pnl_currency_exposure_fx
from
(select business_date,
CASE 
WHEN adjusted_fx_currency IN ('USD','JPY','EUR','CNY','INR') THEN adjusted_fx_currency
ELSE 'Other'
END AS adjusted_fx_currency,
sum(market_value_cad) market_value_cad,
sum(market_value_cad_t_1) market_value_cad_t_1,
sum(cash_flow_cad) cash_flow_cad,
round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2) pnl_cad,
sum(round(pnl_currency_exposure_fx,2)) pnl_currency_exposure_fx,
sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)) pnl_local_exposure_fx,
case when coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)=-1 then 0 else coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) end TWR_CAD,
case when coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)= -1 then 0 else coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) end TWR_Local_Exposure_FX,
(1+ case when coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)=-1 then 0 else coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) end)/(1+ case when coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)= -1 then 0 else coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) end ) -1 TWR_Currency_Adjusted_FX
from performance.pace_holding_pnl
cross join date_params
where performance_configuration_id in ('PC-POOLS')
and model_portfolio_code is not null
and component_type not in (
'Cash',
'Spot',
'Constituent from original',
'Constituent from spot',
'Constituent from generic decomposition',
'Residual from generic decomposition'
)
and cash_state not in ('Settled cash', 'Unsettled cash')
and business_date between date_params.start_date AND date_params.end_date
GROUP BY business_date,
CASE 
WHEN adjusted_fx_currency IN ('USD','JPY','EUR','CNY','INR') THEN adjusted_fx_currency
ELSE 'Other'
end) as DLY
group by adjusted_fx_currency 
order by pnl_currency_exposure_fx limit 50000 -- {"user": "fzhao@cppib.com", "source": "pyxll"}

-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--
-- Acronyms:
--   ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
--   CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
--   CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
--   NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
--   HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--
-- Data Lineage Summary:
--   Security Metadata: reference.ci_sentry_security
--     (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
--   Coupon Metadata:   reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--     (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--
-- Parameters:
--   business_date : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_security.
--
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
--   - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata,
--     includes filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest
--     business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
--   - Created the Issuer CTE to handle scenarios where a security does not have
--     an issuer.
--   - Removed the PARAMS CTE
--   - Added handling for table replacement by environment
--   - Added cppib_security_id to the misc section.

WITH

eligible_securities AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security
    WHERE sentry_security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE) >= CAST(start_date AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE) <= CAST(end_date AS DATE)
),

inv_group_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'CS'    AS inv_group, 'Capital Solutions'    AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC'    AS inv_group, 'European Credit'      AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC'   AS inv_group, 'Real Assets Credit'   AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC'  AS inv_group, 'APAC Credit'          AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'PC'    AS inv_group, 'Public Credit'        AS inv_group_long
),

inv_strategy_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'APAC Capital Solutions'             AS inv_strategy, 'Capital Solutions'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC IG Illiquid'                   AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Real Estate Credit'            AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate Credit'             AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Sponsor Financing'             AS inv_strategy, 'Sponsor Financing'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Antares'                         AS inv_strategy, 'Antares'                        AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Asset Backed'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Asset Backed & Financials'      AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS CLO'                             AS inv_strategy, 'CLO'                            AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Corporates'                      AS inv_strategy, 'Corporates'                     AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IP & Royalties'                  AS inv_strategy, 'Life Science & IP'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Latam'                           AS inv_strategy, 'Latam'                          AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Corporate Rel Val'               AS inv_strategy, 'Corporate Rel Val'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC NPLs'                            AS inv_strategy, 'NPLs'                           AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Structured Credit'               AS inv_strategy, 'Structured Credit'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Infrastructure'                 AS inv_strategy, 'Infrastructure'                 AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Real Estate'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Sustainable Energies Credit'    AS inv_strategy, 'Sustainable Energies'           AS inv_sub_strategy_override
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
),

issuer_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_issuer AS issuer
    WHERE CAST(issuer.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(issuer.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(issuer.end_date AS DATE)
)

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (

    ),

			query_date,

				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,

        SELECT

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/
)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class"

WITH RankedTransactions AS (

               PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id,

           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT st.*
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        and es.mic = rec.mic
		and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
            abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
            amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,

            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)

    WITH max_business_date AS (

        AND m.model_portfolio_id = i.model_portfolio

	client_ip

SELECT h.model_portfolio_id AS MPDEFS_MP,
h.abor_security_id AS SECURITIES_SECSHORT,
MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALP,
MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number < 0 THEN -1 * h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALS,
t.party_name AS PARTNERS_BROKERNAME,
t.trade_date AS SECURITIES_ISSDATE,
h.abor_maturity_date AS PFCKEYRATIOS_MATDATE,
h.portfolio_id AS PORTFOLIOS_POR,
MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.quotation_currency_code ELSE NULL END) AS HOLKEYS_QUOCURP,
h.security_group_id AS SECGROUPS_SECGRP,

h.portfolio_group_name AS PORTGROUPS_PORGRP

select DISTINCT t.abor_security_id , t.trade_date, p.party_name
from trades_deals.scd_transactions t

and t.business_transaction_code in ('SellFXFwdDbd','BuyFXFwdDbd','InitHoldNom','InitHold')
and t.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'

and (t.party_name not like 'INTERNAL CPTY%'
or (trim(h.portfolio_id) = 'S PARENT' and t.party_name like 'INTERNAL CPTY%'))
and h.security_group_id in ('FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF')
and h.balance_nominal_number != 0
GROUP BY
h.model_portfolio_id,
h.abor_security_id,
t.party_name,
t.trade_date,
h.abor_maturity_date,
h.portfolio_id,
h.security_group_id,

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 13
		AND hour between 11 and 12
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-13 11:51:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH latest_meta_run_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(df_meta_run_date) AS max_run_date
    FROM df_trusted_prod.markit_credit_index_component
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
),
latest_file_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(file_date) AS max_file_date
    FROM market.markit_credit_index
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
)
SELECT
    idx.index_family,
    idx.index_name,
    idx.annex_date,
    idx.index_series,
    idx.index_version,
    idx.index_factor,
    comp.index_clip,
    comp.component_ref_entity_ticker,
    comp.component_ref_entity_name,
    comp.component_ref_entity_red,
    comp.component_ref_entity_record_date,
    comp.component_ref_entity_type,
    comp.component_ref_entity_weight AS component_weight,
    comp.component_coupon_type,
    comp.component_currency,
    comp.component_maturity,
    comp.component_coupon,
    evt.red_entity_code,
    evt.reference_entity,
    evt.ticker,
    evt.cerrd AS event_determination_date,
    evt.corporateaction_event_date,
    evt.default_date,
    evt.type,
    evt.event_type,
    evt.auction_date,
    evt.tier_name,
    evt.auction_price,
    evt.auction_cash_settlement_date AS settlement_date

    ON comp.component_ref_entity_red = evt.red_entity_code
JOIN market.markit_credit_index AS idx
    ON idx.index_clip = comp.index_clip

    comp.df_meta_run_date = (SELECT max_run_date FROM latest_meta_run_date)
    AND idx.file_date = (SELECT max_file_date FROM latest_file_date)
    AND SUBSTRING(comp.index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
    AND evt.auction_date IS NOT NULL

    idx.index_series ASC, idx.index_version ASC, comp.component_ref_entity_ticker ASC

        max(arrival_time) over (partition by rm_id, business_date_adj) as max_publish

			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'

			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"
